title: Keep page sizes and usage gauges in range

blocks.text: The reporting API has two range bugs. A scraper that asks for `?size=4294967346` gets pages of 50 rows and pages through the whole table, where anyone asking for more than the maximum should get the largest page. And the usage page of a new account, which has no quota yet and has used nothing, draws its gauge as `NaN` and breaks the chart.

Finish `pageSize(requested)` and `gauge(used, quota)` in `src/main/java/practice/Limits.java`. The web layer has already parsed `?size=` into a `long`. Each method's comment says what it must return. About three lines in total.

cases.says: ordinary sizes stay between 1 and the maximum page, and the gauge stays between empty and full
a requested size too large for an int still gets the largest page, not a small one
zero used out of a zero quota draws an empty gauge, not an undefined one

origin.section: Math.clamp Narrows a long Without Wrapping and Refuses a Reversed Range

concepts: Math.clamp(long, int, int) narrows a long without wrapping, where casting first wraps; clamp throws when min > max and returns NaN for a NaN value.
